title: Solution Architect
jobDescription:
Role &

RESPONSIBILITIES:
You'll work as part of a team of Strategic Thinkers, Capability enhancer, addressing client challenges
- problem solvers, helping to solve complex business issues from strategy to execution. Professional skills and responsibilities for this level includes: Defining and documenting the overall End to End solution architecture Working together with stakeholders to comprehend their needs and requirements Evaluating and selecting appropriate technologies and platforms for the solution Developing and maintaining architectural standards and best practices Ensuring that the solution meets performance, scalability, and security requirements Providing technical guidance and support to development teams Identifying and mitigating potential risks and issues related to the solution Participating in the continuous improvement of the solution and its components Lead and Co-drive engagements for clients across industry sectors and support initiatives across competency for CRM, Billing and Marketplaces platforms. Contribute to practice growth by leveraging experience and best practices Hire, retain, and develop a high-performing, diverse and inclusive team. Actively participate in strategizing Sales and Solutioning activities in platform contributing to improve the win ratio and Business success. Participate and contribute as required to promote Salesforce by collaborating with stakeholders Use a broad range of tools and techniques to extract insights from current industry or sector trends and initialize Marketplace capabilities for Enterprise products. Plan and prioritize own and project teams work. Follow tasks to their logical conclusion and make sure that everything has been done to the right standard. Provide inputs on the development of design, implementation, operations, user guides, and training materials. Provide inputs on evaluation, selection, implementation and maintenance of Tools and Technologies ensuring appropriate investment in strategic and operational systems. Provide responsive advice, counsel, education, and service concerning IT issues and trends in the IT industry. Maintain knowledge and understanding of current and emerging technologies, equipment, and systems. Review and provide input standard operating procedures. Collaborate with other technical and non-technical team members, clients, and vendors to define, build, and deliver solutions. Required

QUALIFICATIONS:
Full-time 10+ years of Solution Architect and Designer role in IT experience; Prior consulting, Professional Services and/or Enterprise Experience preferred. Experience in designing or implementing Enterprise Digital Marketplace platforms, Partner Portals, Commerce platforms, or Digital Product Catalog solutions. Good understanding of Marketplace business capabilities including Product Catalog, Pricing, Offers, Inventory, Partner Management, Order Management, Fulfilment, Billing, Settlement, and Customer Journey. Experience with API-led architecture, API Management platforms (Apigee, Kong, Mule Soft, Azure API Management, AWS API Gateway, etc.). Experience designing event-driven architectures using Kafka, Rabbit MQ, Azure Service Bus, AWS Event Bridge, or similar messaging technologies. Experience integrating CRM, Billing, ERP, Identity Management, Payment Gateway, and Digital Channels. Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture, containerization (Docker), Kubernetes/Open Shift, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and Dev Sec Ops practices. Experience with solution architecture documentation including Architecture Decision Records (ADR), High-Level Design (HLD), Low-Level Design (LLD), sequence diagrams, and integration architecture. Understanding of Marketplace KPIs such as partner onboarding time, product onboarding, order success rate, transaction throughput, and platform availability. Experience working with Telecom BSS/OSS ecosystems would be an added advantage. AI & Intelligent Automation Skills Basic understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AI-assisted enterprise applications. Ability to identify opportunities to incorporate AI capabilities into Marketplace solutions such as intelligent product discovery, recommendation engines, conversational assistants, and knowledge search. Understanding of AI integration using enterprise APIs and cloud AI services (Azure Open AI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or equivalent). Awareness of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts and enterprise knowledge management use cases. Familiarity with AI governance, responsible AI principles, data privacy, security, and compliance considerations. Experience using AI-powered developer productivity tools (e.g., Git Hub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, or equivalent) is desirable. Ability to collaborate with Data Science and AI teams for integrating AI capabilities into enterprise Marketplace platforms. Additional Preferred Skills Experience with Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, SAP, Oracle, Service Now, or similar enterprise platforms. Exposure to Digital Commerce or Marketplace platforms such as Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce, SAP Commerce Cloud, commerce tools, Mirakl, VTEX, or similar. Knowledge of TM Forum Open APIs, Open Digital Architecture (ODA), and Telecom BSS standards is an advantage. Relevant cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) and architecture certifications (TOGAF, Salesforce, or equivalent) are preferred. Industry Type : IT Services, Telecom & Consulting

EDUCATION:
Any Engineering Bachelor’s degree (B.E, B. title: Team Member- Fault Management
jobDescription:
Location: CNOC-Hyderabad

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Need to work on Network/Service incidents using UA tool (SIA/NIA)
2. Identify and log network faults, performance issues, and outages in real time.
3. Raise incidents and alerts as per defined SOPs and escalate as per escalation matrix, including communicating with end customers.
4. Perform initial analysis and basic L1 troubleshooting to determine the nature of the fault.
5. Coordinate with L2/L3, field, TAC and vendor teams for resolution and service restoration.
6. Generate and share daily fault summary reports.
7. Operate in shift (24x7 environment) & ensuring seamless handover between shifts. Requirement :
1. Understanding of SDH,DWDM,OTN & Tx telecom fundamentals.
2. Excellent communication and coordination abilities(English & Hindi).
3. Willingness to work in rotational shifts (24x7).
4. Engineering background (B. Tech) is desirable.
5. Should have sound knowledge in rerouting in ECI and NOKIA NMS
6. Should have good understanding and troubleshooting skills for Customer issues
7.
